root_cause.text: In xfrm6_rcv_encap(), when ip6_route_input_lookup() returns a dst entry with an error, the function jumps to the drop path without releasing the reference to that dst, causing a dst entry memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "ip6_route_input_lookup() returns a referenced dst entry even when the lookup resolves to an error route" and that "the dst is not released before jumping to the drop path". The patch explicitly adds `dst_release(dst);` before the `goto drop;` when `dst->error` is set, confirming that the missing release was the issue.

Completion of the function call that acquires the dst reference.

Unconditional jump to the drop path, bypassing the dst release and causing a memory leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition checks if the dst entry returned by ip6_route_input_lookup has an error; when true, control jumps to the drop path without releasing the dst reference, causing a memory leak.
This unconditional jump bypasses the dst release, directly causing the dst entry reference to be leaked when dst->error is true.

Completion of the ip6_route_input_lookup call that returns the dst entry with an acquired reference; the reference is not released on error.
